title: Step 10 - Building a Document-Term Matrix for NLP Text Classification

cues.en: -: Hello, welcome to this editorial.

cues.en: or random forest.

cues.en: And keep in mind that you can also use naive base which is commonly used as well for natural language processing. But here in this tutorial we will choose random forest classification.
cues.zh: 也記得常見的 Naive Bayes，但這堂選隨機森林分類。
